title: loom-commit-abort
log_line: Loom commit/abort: incoming and reach <= tau, bang-bang to Y_pred, else error_y. Window 24. Pass is a goalie veto, not a title. Self-play stays locked.
what: LPLC_loom is tau = dist_x / |vx| when incoming. LC4_loom_center is that loom in own half, logged, not an extra AND. Reach uses paddle_y as registered.

rule.commit: incoming AND tau <= 24 AND reach <= tau

pass.leak_or: If aim offset is off, leak is undefined as a placement leak; then require contact_rate >= move-only arm.
pass.rule: All: (leak <= 0.08 OR (offset off AND contact_rate >= move-only)) AND wins >= 13 AND wins >= 12. Fail any: stop. Pass = commit veto helps goalie, not a title.
